candidate.en: Kumpanija - Čara is one of the five villages on Korčula Island that preserves the Kumpanija sword dance, a chain sword dance of great antiquity performed in summer and listed as UNESCO intangible cultural heritage.
candidate.venue: Čara village

candidate.en: Harvest season - the grape harvest in Carsko Polje in September and early October is one of the most visually striking seasonal events on the island, with the whole field in activity.
candidate.venue: Carsko Polje below the village

candidate.de: Traditional procession draws villagers and visitors from across the island to the church of Gospa od Carskog Polja in the field below the village.
candidate.en: The major religious event of the year in Čara, centred on the church of Gospa od Carskog Polja in the field below the village. A traditional procession draws villagers and visitors from across the island.
candidate.fr: Le principal événement religieux de l'année à Čara, centré sur l'église de Gospa od Carskog Polja dans le champ en dessous du village. Une procession traditionnelle rassemble les villageois et les visiteurs de l'île.
candidate.hr: Glavni vjerski događaj godine u Čari, okrenut crkvi Gospa od Carskog Polja u polju ispod sela. Tradicionalna procesija privlači stanovnike i posjetitelje s cijele otočke.
candidate.it: L'evento religioso principale dell'anno a Čara, centrato sulla chiesa di Gospa od Carskog Polja nel campo sotto il villaggio. Una processione tradizionale raccoglie i villaggi e i visitatori dell'isola.
candidate.sl: Glavni verski dogodek leta v Čari, usmerjen k cerkvi Gospa od Carskog Polja v polju pod vasjo. Tradicionalna procesija privablja prebivalce in obiskovalce s celotne otoka.
candidate.venue: Gospa od Carskog Polja
